methods.ctc: Unconstrained individual final-file greedy CTC, jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-chinese-zh-cn revision 99ccb2737be22b8bb50dcfcc39ad4d567fb90cfd; no expected text supplied.
methods.whisper: faster-whisper small int8, individual files for all phonetic CTC differences, no expected-text prompt, no prior-text conditioning; final changed clips rechecked separately.
methods.segmentation: Original source vowel, consonant closure/frication and complete trailing decay reviewed alongside CTC alignment; segmentation uses actual waveform and natural quiet boundaries, not uniformly distributed text timings.
methods.pronunciation: Preserve displayed text and pinyin; same-sound speech-only characters documented for homophones and neutral de; no pitch/speed transformation after synthesis.
methods.pitch: Praat single-character pitch screening is not human pronunciation certification.
